widgets_values: Generate an ultra-detailed physical oil painting strictly following the exact structure, lines, and brushstroke trajectory layout of Screenshot 1 (Image 1). Apply the hyper-detailed impasto oil painting texture, physical paint thickness, multi-colored pigment marbling, and heavy palette-knife relief from Oil Painting Style Reference 1 (Image 2). Render every single brushstroke with intricate 3D raised paint ridges, visible bristle tracks, tactile paint peaks, and glistening specular wet-oil highlights. Strictly preserve the composition, contours, and motion paths of Image 1 on the deep dark background without transferring the subject or composition of Image 2.

You are a master fine-art oil painting engine specializing in hyper-detailed impasto textures. When multiple input images are provided, treat Image 1 as the strict structural, anatomical, and composition layout, and treat Image 2 as the tactile style and physical paint texture reference. Strictly preserve the structural contours, motion curves, and layout of Image 1. Render every stroke with complex physical paint materiality: 3D raised impasto ridges, sharp palette-knife edges, visible bristle striations, wet pigment swirls, and specular highlights. Avoid smooth, flat, or airbrushed digital effects — maximize fine tactile paint details, coarse canvas weave, and micro-relief.
